summary: v70.6.1-final-spec check. I ran all 6 requested node suites and each one finished every assertion and exited 0. No process.exit(0) skip was found. Results: audio-startup 3 PASS, stream-startup PASS, resume-recovery PASS, android-utterance PASS, lifecycle printed '12 lifecycle tests passed', router printed '43 PASS, 0 FAIL'. @babel/parser (allowAwaitOutsideFunction=false) parses index.tsx, voiceClientStt.ts and androidUtterance.ts. All requested source checks match: build tag, continuous=true, the PTT progress-timer guard, the HF press-in no-op, pttHoldTimerRef removed, no awareness speech in the HF no-speech loop, and the 1500ms stop() grace loop. Backend: server.py parses, supervisor shows RUNNING, /api/health returns 200 locally and on the public URL, and backend is unchanged. A new probe (frontend/tests/v70_6_1_spec_probe.cjs) feeds realistic Android native error/end sequences into the real lib code and shows 5 spec violations (5/10 probes pass) that the existing suites miss. Deprecated package found: expo-av.

integration_issues.flow: PTT release in the middle of a phrase (stop() grace)
integration_issues.issue: P9: stop() calls ExpoSpeechRecognitionModule.stop() BEFORE the grace wait. This is a known upstream Android continuous race (jamsch/expo-speech-recognition#158): native stop() can emit error 'client' instead of the final result. The error handler (voiceClientStt.ts:645-724) ignores stopRequested, so it cancels the utterance and fires onError('client_stt_client'). Even committed text is lost. index.tsx:3923 recognitionInterrupted then pauses the session and shows 'Il riconoscimento vocale si è interrotto'. This fits the user's 'returns to idle' symptom.

P3: native 'no-speech' + 'end' while the finger is still down makes the end handler (voiceClientStt.ts:739-756) fire onError('no_speech'), which closes the turn. Nothing restarts the native recognizer while PTT is held. The existing 20s test never emits native events.
P4: AndroidUtterance.serviceEnded() (androidUtterance.ts:77-86) ignores autoEndpoint=false. After a 5s pause, a native 'end' calls finish() and dispatches the text BEFORE release.

integration_issues.flow: stop() with committed + pending partial and no native final
integration_issues.issue: P2: after the grace window, stop() (voiceClientStt.ts:1131-1135) dispatches safeText only, and the partial tail is silently dropped. The user spec says safeText-only is insufficient.

P8: partial only, then native 'end' during the grace. The end handler at voiceClientStt.ts:779-786 dispatches currentTranscript, partial included. Without an end event the same case returns nomatch, so the outcome is non-deterministic.

The garbled speech only runs in the HF useEffect, which returns early when handsFree=false. In PTT, nomatch produces no 'Non ho sentito bene' speech, and nomatchObservedRef (index.tsx:3912) stays true and leaks into a later HF turn.

integration_issues.flow: nomatch in HF counts as a silent attempt
integration_issues.issue: index.tsx:2983-2992 comment says nomatch does not count as no_speech. In practice speakAwareness changes status, which clears the restart; the effect then runs again with turnHadSpeechRef=false and counts no_speech #1. No awarenessLinesGarbled line literally says 'Non ho sentito bene'.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av ^16.0.8 is still a dependency and imported. Reference: /app/frontend/lib/quotaExhaustedAudio.ts:22, /app/frontend/package.json:30

action_items: HIGH: in voiceClientStt.stop(), when a partial is pending, wait for the native final BEFORE calling ExpoSpeechRecognitionModule.stop() (or treat a 'client' error as benign when stopRequested). Fall back to safeText or committed+partial, never client_stt_client. Reproduce with P9.
HIGH: PTT held (autoEndpoint=false, stopRequested=false): on native 'no-speech' + 'end', restart the native recognizer and keep the WS and accumulator until release. Reproduce with P3.
HIGH: AndroidUtterance.serviceEnded() must not finish() when autoEndpoint=false. Reproduce with P4.
MEDIUM: pick one post-grace policy for committed + pending partial (P2 drops the tail) and apply the same rule to the end-during-grace path (P8).
MEDIUM: speak the garbled line in PTT too, and reset nomatchObservedRef at the start of each turn.
LOW: align the nomatch counting comment with actual behaviour; add a literal 'Non ho sentito bene' line.
Add probe scenarios P2-P4, P8 and P9 to the regression suite scripts/test-android-utterance.cjs.
Migrate lib/quotaExhaustedAudio.ts from expo-av to expo-audio.
critical_code_review_comments: The existing 'late final' test asserts dispatch.length >= 1 without checking content; the probe confirms the content is correct. The 'PTT 20s' test only covers JS timers.

The legacy non-streaming stopTalk path (index.tsx:4267, 4347, 4550-4556) still speaks awarenessLinesNoAudio and awarenessLoopExit ('Ti aspetto') after 4 empty turns. It is only reachable when EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_WS_VOICE_STREAM=false or on web (.env has true).
In HF ON, a hold over 500ms triggers the long-press kill-switch instead of starting the turn, so a slow tap will not start listening.
index.tsx is 9676 lines and voiceClientStt.ts is 1584, far over the 700-line guideline.
tsc --noEmit reports existing type errors in index.tsx; Metro is not blocked, since Babel parses fine.

success_rate.frontend: Requested suites 6/6 PASS; source checks 10/10; realistic spec probes 5/10

context_for_next_testing_agent: In /app/frontend, run `node tests/v70_6_1_spec_probe.cjs`; it must reach 10/10 after the fixes. The 6 original suites and the babel parse check must stay green. The backend is untouched.
rca_of_issue: The existing harnesses never emit native 'error' or 'end' while PTT is held or during the stop() grace. So the source passes the JS-timer checks but breaks the spec on realistic Android sequences: native stop() is issued before the final arrives (upstream #158), native end/no-speech while held ends the turn, and serviceEnded() ignores autoEndpoint.
